justification: Permissionless execution is intentional, not permissionless scheduling. Only immutable GOVERNOR can schedule operationId(chainId,this,target,value,data,salt); execute requires that exact scheduled hash after immutable delay and marks used before the external call. Arbitrary changed recipient/value/calldata or replay cannot use the approval.

Mapping values are empty storage arrays by Solidity initialization. linkAccount aliases _accountHistory[key] as hist and hist.push writes the same storage; unlinkAccount updates hist[last].to. The detector misses writes through the storage-array alias. The history lookup, length and duplicate/relink paths are exercised.

Only borrow and executeReservedDraw reach this internal function, both holding the manager _lock=2 mutex. Vault.lend separately holds its mutex and validates exact outgoing and recipient deltas. Reentrant borrowing cannot create debt; a recipient shortfall rolls back reservation, ledger, vault and token changes atomically.

repayFor holds the manager mutex before transferFrom. It freshly measures actual vault balance after transfer, allocates that delta once and Vault.onRepayment independently validates the unaccounted arrival delta. Same-manager reentry is blocked; cross-router nested accounting cannot pass the outer tracked-delta check twice.

fundReserve holds _lock=1 before transferFrom. All reserve funding, application, return and writeOff cash paths hold the same mutex. Fresh after-minus-before must equal requested amount before pledgedReserve increases. Role-free funding grants no ability to apply/withdraw someone else's reserve; balances remain outside LP NAV.

Internal helper is only called by repayFor and repayExact, both nonReentrant. The saved balance is intentionally the pre-transfer baseline and is compared with a new balance read. Vault.onRepayment adds an independent tracked-cash check; callback regression proves exactly one allocation.

Internal helper is only called from role-gated recordDestinationReceipt or receiveSettlement under the same router mutex. The fresh delta is recorded as pending custody, never debt repayment or LP NAV. Duplicate settlement IDs are rejected; token callbacks cannot reenter another router cash path.

Internal helper is only called by role-gated allocate or receiveSettlement under the router mutex. Receipt allocated and totalPending are updated before transfer. Fresh vault receipt delta must exactly equal allocated amount, then vault tracked-delta check prevents double accounting. Failure restores receipt and ledger atomically.

Only servicer-gated sweep reaches this helper while holding the escrow mutex. isSwept is committed before Source.withdraw; all escrow claim/sweep/refund/release cash paths share the mutex. A fresh received balance delta must equal the classified payout; fee-on-transfer and reentry regressions reject ambiguous delivery.

Function explicitly checks _lock and sets it to 1 before any external calls, clearing only on success. Route adapter, destination token/chain, deadline and minReceived are validated and settlement ID marked first. Only fresh received delta is approved to the mutex-protected router; no balance baseline is reused in a nested receive.

Every caller (withdraw, claimWithdrawal, claimEpochRecovery, lend, refundExcess) holds the shared vault mutex. State/liability and share debits precede transfer; both vault outgoing and recipient incoming balances are freshly re-read and must equal the expected transfer. Callback and outgoing-transfer-fee tests show no reserved-claim consumption or second withdrawal.
